text: Scarcely had they drunk the water when a sudden glow of cheerful sunshine seemed to brighten their faces, and the deep furrows of age began to fade away. <break time="0.8s" /> Give us more of this wondrous water, they cried eagerly, and with every glass the years seemed to roll back like a dream from which they were waking. <break time="0.8s" /> Mister Gascoignes mind seemed to run on political topics, and he talked in a deep, important voice about patriotism and national glory, though nobody could tell what he really meant. <break time="0.8s" /> Colonel Killigrew began to sing a merry drinking song, while Mister Medbourne was busy calculating a plan for supplying the East Indies with ice by harnessing whales to the polar icebergs. <break time="0.8s" /> As for the Widow Wycherly, she stood before the mirror, curtsying and simpering to her own image, and greeting it as the friend she loved better than all the world. <break time="0.8s" /> Soon the three gentlemen began to compete for her favor, each trying to snatch her hand, and their old rivalry burst into flame as if not a single day had passed. <break time="0.8s" /> In the struggle, the table was overturned, and the precious vase was dashed into a thousand fragments, while the Water of Youth flowed in a bright stream across the floor. <break time="0.8s" /> A butterfly, which had grown old and was ready to die, alighted on the snowy head of Doctor Heidegger after it had been touched by a few drops.
